question_or_proposition: For the Whole Effluent Toxicity testing rows marked 'Once/5 years (*2)', does footnote (2) — 'Perform WET testing at first discharge' — make WET monitoring event-triggered at the first discharge (rather than on a fixed five-year calendar schedule alone), and therefore determine whether WET monitoring was required during Federal FY2025 and how to classify absent WET results when no qualifying discharge occurred?
required_context: Part I WET testing table: Ceriodaphnia dubia and Pimephales promelas with measurement frequency 'Once/5 years (*2)'
Footnote (2): 'Perform WET testing at first discharge.'
Footnote (3) cross-reference to Part II for additional WET monitoring and reporting conditions
Evidence of whether and when discharges from Outfall 001 occurred during Federal FY2025 and relative to permit effective date or any prior WET cycle
notes: The nominated footnote qualifies the WET monitoring frequency column and is ambiguous about whether testing is tied to a first-discharge trigger versus a standalone five-year interval. That distinction changes monitoring-applicability determinations (Purpose B) and the semantics of missing WET evidence (Purpose C). Purpose A is unaffected because the adjacent WET rows specify 'Report' values with no enforceable numeric limit for compliance comparison.
